keyEvents.text: Goal! Torreense 1, Ararat-Armenia 0. Jorge Aguirre (Torreense) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Javi Vázquez with a cross.
Jorge Aguirre (Torreense) is shown the red card.
Substitution, Torreense. Musa Drammeh replaces Karem Zoabi.
Goal! Torreense 1, Ararat-Armenia 1. Karen Muradyan (Ararat-Armenia) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Zhirayr Shaghoyan with a cross.
Bruno Wilson (Ararat-Armenia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match (Ararat-Armenia).
Delay in match (Torreense).
Karen Muradyan (Ararat-Armenia) is shown the yellow card.
Volnei Feltes (Torreense) is shown the yellow card.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Benny (Ararat-Armenia) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Torreense 1, Ararat-Armenia 2. Bruno Wilson (Ararat-Armenia) header from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Artur Serobyan with a cross following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Torreense. Luis Quintero replaces Manu Pozo.
Substitution, Torreense. David Bruno replaces Jonathan Mutombo.
Substitution, Ararat-Armenia. Zidane Banjaqui replaces Benny.
Substitution, Ararat-Armenia. Franca replaces Zhirayr Shaghoyan.
Substitution, Torreense. Amine Oudrhiri replaces João Marques.
Substitution, Torreense. Juan María Alcedo replaces Dany Jean.
João Bravim (Ararat-Armenia) is shown the red card.
Substitution, Ararat-Armenia. Arman Nersesyan replaces Artur Serobyan.
Arman Nersesyan (Ararat-Armenia) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Ararat-Armenia. Kamo Hovhannisyan replaces Juan Balanta.
Franca (Ararat-Armenia) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Ararat-Armenia. Maxence Carlier replaces Hugo Oliveira.
Musa Drammeh (Torreense) is shown the yellow card.
Gustavo Sousa Alhinho Alves Rijo (Torreense) Yellow Card at 88'
Goal! Torreense 2, Ararat-Armenia 2. Javi Vázquez (Torreense) header from very close range to the top left corner. Assisted by David Bruno with a cross.
Goal! Torreense 3, Ararat-Armenia 2. Musa Drammeh (Torreense) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Second Half ends, Torreense 3, Ararat-Armenia 2.
